# Auxillary functions for metabolome analysis

## 1. KEGG Annotation

Extract all compounds found in human pathways

```{r}
library(KEGGREST)
# Retrieve all KEGG pathways for humans
human_pathways <- keggList("pathway", "hsa")
hsa_ids <- names(human_pathways)

# function to extract compounds and class names for specific pathway
get_pathway_info <- function(pathway_id) {
  pathway_info <- keggGet(pathway_id)
  if (!is.null(pathway_info[[1]]$COMPOUND) && !is.null(pathway_info[[1]]$CLASS)) {
    compounds <- names(pathway_info[[1]]$COMPOUND)
    class_info <- str_split(pathway_info[[1]]$CLASS, "; ")[[1]][2]
    name <- str_split(pathway_info[[1]]$NAME, " -")[[1]][1]
    return(list(compounds = compounds, class = class_info, name = name))
  } else {
    return(NULL)
  }
}

hsa_to_compound_list <- list()
hsa_to_class_list <- list()
hsa_to_name_list <- list()

# Loop over pathways to extract compounds, class names, and pathway names
for (hsa in hsa_ids) {
  pathway_info <- get_pathway_info(hsa)
  if (!is.null(pathway_info)) {
    hsa_to_compound_list[[hsa]] <- pathway_info$compounds
    hsa_to_class_list[[hsa]] <- pathway_info$class
    hsa_to_name_list[[hsa]] <- pathway_info$name
  }
}

# Combine the results into a single dataframe
hsa_to_compound_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(hsa_to_compound_list), function(hsa) {
  compounds <- hsa_to_compound_list[[hsa]]
  class_info <- hsa_to_class_list[[hsa]]
  name_info <- hsa_to_name_list[[hsa]]
  if (!is.null(compounds) && !is.null(class_info) && !is.null(name_info)) {
    data.frame(PathwayID = hsa, CompoundID = compounds, Class = class_info, Name = name_info, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }
}))

## save
write.csv(hsa_to_compound_df, file = "/Volumes/G_DQBM_BB_Central$/users/lasmey/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/data_analysis/cpd_in_hsa_pathways",row.names = TRUE)
```


## 2. Mass adduct search

Adducts and their Mass correction
[M - H]⁻ => +1.0078250   
M - H2O]⁻ => +18.0105646
M - H2O - H]⁻ => +19.0183896
[M + K - 2H]⁻ => -36.9480565
[M + Na - 2H]⁻ => -20.9741193
[M + Cl]⁻ => -34.9688527

Perform search for all Mass corrections above

```{r}
mass_adduct <- -34.9688527 # adjust Mass correction (see above)

masses <- peak_anno$Mass %>% unique

df_result <- data.frame(matrix(ncol = 8, nrow = 0))
colnames(df_result) <- c("mz","mass_adduct", "query", "kegg_id","result_name", "result_mass", "result_pathway", "hmdb_id")

# function call to KEGG
get_compound <- function(mass, mass_adduct, ppm) {
  tolerance <- mass * (ppm / 10^6) # calculate the tolerance on the observed mass
  mass <- mass+mass_adduct
  lower_bound <- mass - tolerance
  upper_bound <- mass + tolerance
  query <- paste0(lower_bound, "-", upper_bound)
  results <- keggFind("compound", query, option = "exact_mass")
  return(list(query = query, results = results))
}

get_compound_information <- function(C_number){
  compound_info <- keggGet(C_number)
  Sys.sleep(0.34)
  result_name <-  paste0(compound_info[[1]]$NAME,  collapse = " ")
  result_mass <- compound_info[[1]]$EXACT_MASS
  result_pathway <- ifelse(is.null(compound_info[[1]]$PATHWAY), NA, paste0(names(compound_info[[1]]$PATHWAY),  collapse = ", "))
  db_links <- compound_info[[1]]$DBLINKS
  hmdb_id <- ifelse( TRUE %in% grepl("HMDB", db_links), db_links[grepl("HMDB", db_links)], NA)
  return(list(result_name = result_name, result_mass = result_mass, result_pathway = result_pathway, hmdb_id = hmdb_id))
}


for (mass in masses){
  kegg_result <- get_compound(mass, mass_adduct, 4)
  Sys.sleep(0.34) # systems only allows 3 queries per second

  # extract information per compound
  if (length(kegg_result$results) != 0){
    for (j in seq_along(kegg_result$results)){
      C_number <- str_split(names(kegg_result$results)[j], ":")[[1]][2]
      compound_info <- get_compound_information(C_number)

      new_row <- data.frame(mz = mass,
                            mass_adduct = mass+mass_adduct,
                            query = kegg_result$query,
                            kegg_id = C_number,
                            result_name = compound_info$result_name,
                            result_mass = compound_info$result_mass,
                            result_pathway = compound_info$result_pathway,
                            hmdb_id = compound_info$hmdb_id,
                            stringsAsFactors = FALSE
                                        )
      df_result <- rbind(df_result, new_row)
    }

  } else {
    new_row <- data.frame(mz = mass,
                          mass_adduct = mass+mass_adduct,
                          query = kegg_result$query,
                          kegg_id = NA,
                          result_name = NA,
                          result_mass = NA,
                          result_pathway = NA,
                          hmdb_id = NA,
                          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
                                      )
    df_result <- rbind(df_result, new_row)
  }
}
```

```{r}
# Function to format dataframe with limited column width
format_df <- function(df, width = 20) {
  df %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ substring(., 1, width)))
}


peak_anno %>% as.data.frame() %>% filter(adduct == "M+K-2H", !is.na(kegg_id))
format_df(df_result %>% as.data.frame() %>% filter(!is.na(result_name)) %>%select(mz, result_name, kegg_id, result_pathway))

mz_peak_anno <- peak_anno %>% as.data.frame() %>% filter(adduct == "M+K-2H", !is.na(kegg_id)) %>% select(Mass) %>% unique %>% pull(Mass) # 73
mz_df_result <- df_result %>% as.data.frame() %>% filter(!is.na(result_name)) %>%select(mz) %>% unique %>% pull(mz) # 108

# how many don't overlap?
setdiff(mz_df_result, mz_peak_anno) %>% length # 47
```
